observations.description: PREFLIGHT_ONLY is default. -Execute switch required for physical execution. Mode field distinguishes. Preflight exits before Stop-ScheduledTask.
Only BTC task stopped/started. ES-NQ, watchdog, and delivery tasks never stopped, started, enabled, disabled, registered, or unregistered.
Preflight: BTC Running, ES/NQ Ready, watchdog Ready, delivery Ready, all single-action IgnoreNew, ES/NQ last_result=0 + no missed runs, BTC fresh poll (<90s), zero gaps.
All four tasks checked for single action and IgnoreNew in foreach loop.
Stale hold bounded 91-180 seconds (default 95). Recovery timeout 60-600 seconds (default 180).
Real watchdog runner produces UNHEALTHY transition with btc-recorder in reasons and STALE_HEARTBEAT or TASK_NOT_RUNNING. Unhealthy alert state verified.
Unhealthy alert delivered via delivery runner, read back from OneDrive inbox, envelope SHA-256 recorded, event_id recorded.
Recovery: BTC started, Running state required, post poll must be genuinely newer than pre poll.
Recovery watchdog produces HEALTHY transition for both status and alert.
Recovery alert delivered, read back from OneDrive, envelope SHA-256 and event_id recorded.
BTC gap count must remain unchanged. ES/NQ state, result, run time, missed runs, and evidence must remain unchanged. es_nq_collector_operated=false.
Failure: DRILL_FAILED recorded, failure_reason captured, BTC recovery attempted, evidence written, rethrows.
Evidence: repository-contained, atomic (WriteAllText+Move-Item), content-addressed (SHA256 report_id), trading_authority=false, schema=controlled-stale-alert-drill-v1.
No credentials, provider SDKs, wallet, broker, exchange, signing, live trading, or paper order submission.
OneDrive sink: env resolution (process then user), TradingSystem\AlertEvidence path, sink-manifest.json checked, delivery path computed from sink_id + event_id.

Report fields: schema_version, mode, started_at, completed_at, result (PREFLIGHT_VERIFIED/STALE_ALERT_AND_RECOVERY_VERIFIED), stale_observed, recovery_observed, btc_pre/post_poll, btc_pre/post_gap, es_nq_pre/post, unhealthy/healthy event_id and envelope_sha256.

redundant: Some adversarial tests overlap with existing on preflight default, BTC-only control, bounded intervals, watchdog transitions, OneDrive envelopes, ES/NQ unchanged, failure handling, no trading
